file_purpose: Replication record for the VS13 length experiments as documented in length_estimation/README.md. The eval JSON and checkpoints are not in this checkout, so the numbers below are copied from that README and cannot be re-derived from a local metrics file.

dataset.name: VS13
dataset.layout: {Vehicle}/{Vehicle}_{speed}.wav plus a txt sidecar of speed_kmh and cpa_time_s

phase_a.protocol: Leave-one-vehicle-out. Physics and Ridge/RF models on hand-crafted timing features.
phase_a.verdict: Hand-crafted features match the training-set mean on overall length. They are a negative result for length, not a working estimator.

phase_b_split.protocol: About 80/20 clips per vehicle. All 13 vehicles appear in training. Not an unseen-vehicle test.

phase_b_lovo.protocol: 13 folds. Each vehicle is absent from the fold that is scored on it. Pooled MAE is over all 400 clips.

phase_b_model.input: CPA-centred log-mel, 128 by 704, plus speed in km/h divided by 105.

source: length_estimation/README.md Results section. Confirm against outputs/phase_b if those files are restored.
